thread:
javier: kicking off the rollout for use-new-routing-v2 now. deploy starts in 2m, feature flag will be opened to 5% traffic first.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: release/2026-03-20. Nodes: 12. Canary group: 3 pods. Streaming logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/1758400000

emma: noted. can we set the safety windows to 10m between increments? last time 5m was too short.

javier: yes 10m. plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m soak and telemetry checks at each step. thresholds: error rate delta +2pp, p95 latency +250ms.

raj: adding quick retract steps: if threshold hit, ffctl toggle set use-new-routing-v2 false --reason "auto-retract" && pin routing-service to v12.3.1 via pinctl. ops runbook: docs/runbook/fast-retract.md (linked).

leah: can deploy-bot emit an alert to #oncall when auto-retract triggers? want immediate paging.

deploy-bot: yes — will post in #oncall and create incident with tags: service=routing, trigger=ff-auto-retract. Also will attach the last 200 lines of logs.

emma: also request we snapshot the prefix cache before the 60% step. failing cache warm is what caused the earlier surge. command: curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/cache/snapshot?service=routing

javier: good call. do that during the 20% soak window.

raj: quick config I pushed to staging:```\n{\n  "flag": "use-new-routing-v2",\n  "steps": [5,20,60,100],\n  "soak_minutes": 10,\n  "auto_retract_conditions": {\n    "error_rate_pp_delta": 2.0,\n    "p95_latency_ms_delta": 250\n  }\n}\n```

leah: @oncall-bot can you ensure the pager escalation is 1-2-5 and that the runbook link is included in the incident?

oncall-bot: escalation set: 1min -> primary, 3min -> secondary, 10min -> pager duty. runbook attached.

emma: small nit: add a temporary sampling flag for verbose traces for routing.v2 for the 20% window so we get better diagnostics without costing too much. set trace_sample=0.1.

javier: agreed. we'll enable traces only for cohorts in 20% window and disable after 60% unless we see anomalies.

deploy-bot: Canary stable at 5% after 10m. metrics: error_rate delta 0.1pp, p95 latency +20ms. advancing to 20% now.

emma: snapshot complete. cache warm looks good.

raj: pushing pin for rollback readiness: pinctl set routing-service:v12.3.1 --reason "pre-rollout pin".

leah: thumbs up from infra on quotas. monitoring alert rules are enabled. I'll shadow the dashboards for the next 40m.

deploy-bot: Reached 20% soak window complete. metrics nominal. advancing to 60%.

javier: hold here if anything unusual shows up. if we get an auto-retract, we follow playbook: 1) ffctl toggle set use-new-routing-v2 false 2) pin rollout 3) open incident 4) run rollback tests.

emma: if we end up retracting, let's capture a short release note for customers: "We rolled back routing update v2 for stability; safely re-enabled previous path. Investigating cache warm behavior."

leah: noted. I'll draft the note in #marketing-distro if needed.

deploy-bot: Advanced to 60%. will wait full 10m soak then finalize 100%.

javier: thanks team. stay on call for the next 30m. :eyes:
